_comment: MECH-IMPORT-GLB-PACK-MANIFEST-1: explicit source of truth for imported GLB
assets under data/tgl/. Each entry declares a source_type:
tracked   = committed in git, must exist in the repo (small).
external  = distributed via an external/deploy pack, too large for git;
installed into data/tgl/ locally; absent by default is OK.
generated = produced by a cook/import step (not committed, regenerable).
Enforced by tools/mech_glb_pack_contract_harness (no game launch, no
tg_import_dump by default). DO NOT commit large GLBs — declare them external.
To add an imported GLB: install/cook it under data/tgl/, add its registry/ini
wiring, and add an entry here. The harness fails if a tracked data/tgl GLB is
undeclared, or a tracked entry is missing, or a path escapes the repo.
